about.descriptionHtml:
I work differently from developers who simply take requirements, write code, and disappear.

I understand the business problem first, challenge what doesn't make sense, and then build the simplest system that solves it properly.

  • I don't automate a broken process just because it can be automated.
  • I don't force every problem into the same tool.
  • I don't call something finished because it worked once in development.

Understand it. Build it. Break it. Test it. Ship it.
That's how I build systems businesses can actually depend on.

Clear scope. Clear communication. Real ownership.

servicesText.heading: Systems built around the business.
servicesText.subheading: Not the tool. From one broken workflow to a complete AI-powered platform, I build the system around what needs to happen next.

services.title: AI Agents That Do Real Work
services.desc: Agents built for lead qualification, customer support, research, document processing, internal operations and multi-step business workflows.

services.title: Connect. Automate. Remove the Manual Work.
services.desc: I connect your apps, APIs and data into workflows that run automatically, without your team constantly moving information between tools.

services.title: Turn Your CRM Into a Revenue System
services.desc: Lead routing, pipeline automation, follow-ups, lifecycle workflows and integrations designed to keep opportunities moving without relying on memory.
services.stack: GoHighLevel · Zoho CRM · HubSpot · Salesforce · Pipedrive

services.title: From Idea to a System People Can Actually Use
services.desc: AI-powered MVPs and SaaS platforms with the backend, authentication, dashboards, payments and integrations needed to operate beyond the demo.

services.title: When Off-the-Shelf Tools Aren't Enough
services.desc: Custom APIs, backend services, webhooks, databases and automation logic for workflows that need more control than standard platforms provide.

services.title: AI That Can Listen, Speak and Take Action
services.desc: Voice agents and intelligent systems for inbound calls, qualification, booking, support and multilingual customer experiences.

partnersText.eyebrow: Trusted To Build What Businesses Depend On
partnersText.subheading: I help businesses turn disconnected tools, manual processes, and ambitious AI ideas into systems that actually work together.
partnersText.description1: From the first workflow to the final deployment, I focus on what matters: less manual work, stronger operations, and systems built to scale with the business.
partnersText.description2: From CRM automation and AI agents to custom APIs and SaaS platforms, every build starts with one question:
partnersText.finalQuestion: What does this need to solve for the business?

workText.heading: Built to solve real business problems.
workText.subheading: AI automation, CRM systems, AI agents and SaaS products built around one thing: Making the business work better.

work.title: CV LABZ
work.desc: From raw information to an ATS-ready CV in minutes. Built an AI-powered SaaS platform that transforms user data into structured, professional resumes automatically.

work.title: THE DIGITAL COUNSEL
work.desc: Follow-up that happens even when your team is busy. Built a 14-day automated SMS and email system that keeps client communication moving without relying on manual follow-ups.

work.title: CHERRETT CHIROPRACTIC
work.desc: Turning an inactive patient database back into appointments. Built an AI-powered reactivation system that starts conversations, handles responses and moves qualified patients toward booking.

work.title: PREPARE2SWIM
work.desc: Automation built to support a 1M+ audience. Fixed critical email-deliverability issues and automated the ManyChat → Kit lead journey for a high-volume digital business.

work.title: PIXELLIFT
work.desc: From low-quality images to usable product assets automatically. Built an AI SaaS workflow that enhances product images without repetitive manual editing.

work.title: LOOMO
work.desc: One platform connecting customers, drivers and payments. Built a multi-sided ride-booking system covering customer journeys, driver operations, payments and live tracking.
